verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a CLI package manager for installing and managing software. AI-generated insights and suggestions drawn from a user's own data is an analytics or SaaS axis, not a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Homebrew ships any AI insight feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
